Too’ close to home’ is how Rep.Lee Zeldin, a Republican running for governor of New York, described the shooting incident Sunday afternoon outside his home.

According to information provided to Fox News by Suffolk County police, the shooting occurred on Long Island around 2:20 PM. The police said the shooting was “unrelated to the residents of the house.”

Rep. Zeldin had been in attendance at the Bronx Columbus Day Parade when the shooting occurred. In a statement made by Zeldin, he reported his two teenage daughters were home alone when the shots were fired.AS CHICAGO BRACES FOR 'ICE INVASION,' DHS SECRETARY NOEM CONFIRMS ITS COMING!

AS CHICAGO BRACES FOR 'ICE INVASION,' DHS SECRETARY NOEM CONFIRMS ITS COMING!

According to Fox News, Zeldin said, “My 16-year-old daughters, Mikayla and Arianna, were at our house doing homework, while my wife, Diana, and I were in the car, having just departed the Bronx Columbus Day Parade in Morris Park.”

“After my daughters heard the gunshots and the screaming, they ran upstairs, locked themselves in the bathroom, and immediately called 911. They acted very swiftly and smartly every step of the way, and Diana and I are extremely proud of them.”NYT REPORTER SCOFFS: ZOHRAN MAMDANI’S ‘SOCIALISM’ IS NOTHING MORE THAN TREATING PEOPLE FAIRLY!

NYT REPORTER SCOFFS: ZOHRAN MAMDANI’S ‘SOCIALISM’ IS NOTHING MORE THAN TREATING PEOPLE FAIRLY!



Zeldin posted a tweet saying one of the fired bullets landed 30 feet from his daughters. He also stated two people were injured and “laying down under my front porch and the bushes in front of our porch.” “My understanding is that they have been transported to area hospitals. I do not know their identities.”DETROIT PRO-PALESTINIAN CONFERENCE SPARKS FURY AFTER SHOCKING CALL TO ‘DESTROY THE IDEA OF AMERICA’

“Law enforcement is currently at our house. My entire family is at home working with the investigators and providing the security footage from our home cameras.”

The Suffolk County Police Department made a statement about the shooting saying two teenagers were injured in the drive-by on Zeldin’s street. Three teenagers were involved. Around 2:19 PM, an SUV drove by the three teenagers walking down the street and fired multiple gunshots. Two 17-year-old males were injured, and a third teenager left the scene.DEM REP. In a press conference on Sunday night, Zeldin stated that the crime crisis in the state is hitting close to home.

Zeldin also stated that 24 hours before the shooting, he was on the front porch with a reporter and giving an interview “talking about rising crime in New York.”CALIFORNIA SCRAMBLES TO DEPLOY SECURITY FOR KAMALA HARRIS!

In response to a reporter asking if politics were appropriate to discuss just hours after the shooting, Zeldin said, “I’m standing in front of crime scene tape in front of my own house. You can’t get me more outraged than right now.”
